catalog_input_fields_bounds_check.name: catalog_input_fields_bounds_check
catalog_input_fields_bounds_check.value:
case "catalog_input_fields"."type"
        when 'digits' then coalesce("catalog_input_fields"."min_length" between 1 and 32, true)
          and coalesce("catalog_input_fields"."max_length" between 1 and 32, true)
        when 'text' then coalesce("catalog_input_fields"."min_length" between 1 and 64, true)
          and coalesce("catalog_input_fields"."max_length" between 1 and 64, true)
        else "catalog_input_fields"."min_length" is null and "catalog_input_fields"."max_length" is null
      end and coalesce("catalog_input_fields"."min_length" <= "catalog_input_fields"."max_length", true)

catalog_input_fields_options_check.name: catalog_input_fields_options_check
catalog_input_fields_options_check.value:
case "catalog_input_fields"."type"
        when 'select' then jsonb_typeof("catalog_input_fields"."options") = 'array'
          and jsonb_array_length("catalog_input_fields"."options") between 2 and 50
        else "catalog_input_fields"."options" is null
      end

catalog_products_code_text_check.name: catalog_products_code_text_check
catalog_products_code_text_check.value: "catalog_products"."kind" = 'code' or ("catalog_products"."region_ar" is null and "catalog_products"."redemption_ar" is null)

announcements_schedule_check.name: announcements_schedule_check
announcements_schedule_check.value: "announcements"."starts_at" is null or "announcements"."ends_at" is null or "announcements"."ends_at" > "announcements"."starts_at"

announcements_link_path_check.name: announcements_link_path_check
announcements_link_path_check.value: "announcements"."link_path" is null or (char_length("announcements"."link_path") <= 200 and "announcements"."link_path" ~ '^/([A-Za-z0-9._~/-]*)?(#[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?$' and "announcements"."link_path" !~ '^//' and "announcements"."link_path" !~ '(^|/)\.\.(/|#|$)')

banners_schedule_check.name: banners_schedule_check
banners_schedule_check.value: "banners"."starts_at" is null or "banners"."ends_at" is null or "banners"."ends_at" > "banners"."starts_at"

banners_link_path_check.name: banners_link_path_check
banners_link_path_check.value: "banners"."link_path" is null or (char_length("banners"."link_path") <= 200 and "banners"."link_path" ~ '^/([A-Za-z0-9._~/-]*)?(#[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)?$' and "banners"."link_path" !~ '^//' and "banners"."link_path" !~ '(^|/)\.\.(/|#|$)')

customer_limits_per_deposit_within_daily.name: customer_limits_per_deposit_within_daily_check
customer_limits_per_deposit_within_daily.value: "customer_limits"."per_deposit_usd_units" is null or "customer_limits"."daily_deposit_usd_units" is null or "customer_limits"."per_deposit_usd_units" <= "customer_limits"."daily_deposit_usd_units"

deposit_settings_qr_check.name: deposit_settings_qr_check
deposit_settings_qr_check.value: (not "deposit_settings"."syp_enabled" or "deposit_settings"."syp_qr_file_id" is not null) and (not "deposit_settings"."usd_enabled" or "deposit_settings"."usd_qr_file_id" is not null)

deposit_settings_limits_check.name: deposit_settings_limits_check
deposit_settings_limits_check.value:
"deposit_settings"."min_deposit_usd_units" > 0 and "deposit_settings"."min_deposit_usd_units" % 10000 = 0 and "deposit_settings"."new_account_per_deposit_usd_units" > 0 and "deposit_settings"."new_account_per_deposit_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and "deposit_settings"."new_account_daily_usd_units" > 0 and "deposit_settings"."new_account_daily_usd_units" % 10000 = 0 and "deposit_settings"."established_per_deposit_usd_units" > 0 and "deposit_settings"."established_per_deposit_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and "deposit_settings"."established_daily_usd_units" > 0 and "deposit_settings"."established_daily_usd_units" % 10000 = 0 and "deposit_settings"."flag_new_account_usd_units" > 0 and "deposit_settings"."flag_new_account_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and "deposit_settings"."min_deposit_usd_units" <= "deposit_settings"."new_account_per_deposit_usd_units"
        and "deposit_settings"."new_account_per_deposit_usd_units" <= "deposit_settings"."new_account_daily_usd_units"
        and "deposit_settings"."min_deposit_usd_units" <= "deposit_settings"."established_per_deposit_usd_units"
        and "deposit_settings"."established_per_deposit_usd_units" <= "deposit_settings"."established_daily_usd_units"

deposits_declared_check.name: deposits_declared_check
deposits_declared_check.value:
"deposits"."declared_amount_units" > 0
        and "deposits"."declared_amount_units" % (case "deposits"."currency" when 'SYP' then 100 else 10000 end) = 0
        and "deposits"."declared_usd_units" >= 0 and "deposits"."declared_usd_units" % 10000 = 0

deposits_quote_check.name: deposits_quote_check
deposits_quote_check.value:
num_nonnulls("deposits"."rate_id", "deposits"."rate", "deposits"."quote_expires_at") = case "deposits"."currency" when 'SYP' then 3 else 0 end
        and ("deposits"."rate" is null or "deposits"."rate" > 0)
        and ("deposits"."rate_fixed_at" is null or "deposits"."currency" = 'SYP')

deposits_receipt_request_check.name: deposits_receipt_request_check
deposits_receipt_request_check.value:
"deposits"."receipt_request_count" between 0 and 1
        and ("deposits"."receipt_requested_at" is not null) = ("deposits"."receipt_request_count" = 1)
        and ("deposits"."receipt_request_note" is null or ("deposits"."receipt_requested_at" is not null and char_length("deposits"."receipt_request_note") between 1 and 300))

deposits_submitted_check.name: deposits_submitted_check
deposits_submitted_check.value: "deposits"."status" not in ('submitted', 'credited', 'rejected') or "deposits"."submitted_at" is not null

deposits_decided_check.name: deposits_decided_check
deposits_decided_check.value:
("deposits"."status" in ('credited', 'rejected')) = ("deposits"."decided_at" is not null)
        and ("deposits"."status" in ('credited', 'rejected')) = ("deposits"."decided_by" is not null)
        and coalesce("deposits"."decided_by" = 'admin', false) = ("deposits"."admin_id" is not null)
        and coalesce("deposits"."decided_by" = 'admin', false) = ("deposits"."decision_idempotency_key" is not null)

deposits_credit_check.name: deposits_credit_check
deposits_credit_check.value:
num_nonnulls("deposits"."transaction_number", "deposits"."received_currency", "deposits"."received_amount_units", "deposits"."credited_usd_units", "deposits"."journal_id")
          = case when "deposits"."status" = 'credited' then 5 else 0 end
        and ("deposits"."reference_check" is not null) = ("deposits"."status" = 'credited' and "deposits"."method" = 'sham_cash')
        and num_nonnulls("deposits"."credit_rate_id", "deposits"."credit_rate")
          = case when "deposits"."status" = 'credited' and "deposits"."received_currency" = 'SYP' then 2 else 0 end
        and ("deposits"."transaction_number" is null or char_length("deposits"."transaction_number") between 1 and 64)
        and ("deposits"."received_amount_units" is null or "deposits"."received_amount_units" > 0)
        and ("deposits"."credited_usd_units" is null or ("deposits"."credited_usd_units" > 0 and "deposits"."credited_usd_units" % 10000 = 0))

deposits_rejection_check.name: deposits_rejection_check
deposits_rejection_check.value:
("deposits"."reject_reason" is not null) = ("deposits"."status" = 'rejected')
        and ("deposits"."customer_note" is null or ("deposits"."status" = 'rejected' and char_length("deposits"."customer_note") between 1 and 300))
        and ("deposits"."reject_reason" <> 'other' or "deposits"."customer_note" is not null)

usdt_deposits_txid_check.name: usdt_deposits_txid_check
usdt_deposits_txid_check.value:
("usdt_deposits"."txid" is null or "usdt_deposits"."txid" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
        and ("usdt_deposits"."txid" is null) = ("usdt_deposits"."txid_source" is null)
        and "usdt_deposits"."txid_submissions" between 0 and 5
        and ("usdt_deposits"."confirmations" is null or "usdt_deposits"."confirmations" >= 0)

merchant_alert_settings_threshold_check.name: merchant_alert_settings_threshold_check
merchant_alert_settings_threshold_check.value:
"merchant_alert_settings"."low_balance_usd_units" is null or ("merchant_alert_settings"."low_balance_usd_units" between 1000000 and 10000000000
        and "merchant_alert_settings"."low_balance_usd_units" % 10000 = 0)

merchant_order_sales_amount_check.name: merchant_order_sales_amount_check
merchant_order_sales_amount_check.value:
"merchant_order_sales"."unit_amount_units" > 0 and "merchant_order_sales"."unit_usd_units" >= 0
        and "merchant_order_sales"."unit_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and ("merchant_order_sales"."currency" = 'usd' or "merchant_order_sales"."rate_id" is not null)
        and ("merchant_order_sales"."currency" <> 'usd' or "merchant_order_sales"."unit_usd_units" = "merchant_order_sales"."unit_amount_units")

merchant_receipt_settings_whatsapp_check.name: merchant_receipt_settings_whatsapp_check
merchant_receipt_settings_whatsapp_check.value:
("merchant_receipt_settings"."whatsapp" is null or "merchant_receipt_settings"."whatsapp" ~ '^[+][1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')
        and (not "merchant_receipt_settings"."show_whatsapp" or "merchant_receipt_settings"."whatsapp" is not null)

merchant_selling_settings_check.name: merchant_selling_settings_check
merchant_selling_settings_check.value:
("merchant_selling_settings"."markup_bp" is null or "merchant_selling_settings"."markup_bp" between 0 and 10000)
        and ("merchant_selling_settings"."syp_step_units" is null or "merchant_selling_settings"."syp_step_units" in (500, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000))

merchant_applications_text_check.name: merchant_applications_text_check
merchant_applications_text_check.value:
char_length("merchant_applications"."trade_name") between 2 and 80
        and char_length("merchant_applications"."city") between 2 and 60
        and char_length("merchant_applications"."street_address") between 5 and 160
        and ("merchant_applications"."activity_other" is null or char_length("merchant_applications"."activity_other") between 2 and 80)
        and ("merchant_applications"."shop_link" is null or (char_length("merchant_applications"."shop_link") <= 300 and "merchant_applications"."shop_link" like 'https://%'))
        and ("merchant_applications"."admin_message" is null or char_length("merchant_applications"."admin_message") between 5 and 500)

merchant_profiles_text_check.name: merchant_profiles_text_check
merchant_profiles_text_check.value: char_length("merchant_profiles"."trade_name") between 2 and 80 and char_length("merchant_profiles"."city") between 2 and 60

merchant_settings_bounds_check.name: merchant_settings_bounds_check
merchant_settings_bounds_check.value:
"merchant_settings"."per_deposit_usd_units" > 0 and "merchant_settings"."per_deposit_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and "merchant_settings"."daily_deposit_usd_units" > 0 and "merchant_settings"."daily_deposit_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and "merchant_settings"."daily_deposit_usd_units" <= 100000000000
        and "merchant_settings"."per_deposit_usd_units" <= "merchant_settings"."daily_deposit_usd_units"
        and "merchant_settings"."orders_per_ten_minutes" between 10 and 500
        and "merchant_settings"."reapply_wait_days" between 0 and 365
        and "merchant_settings"."info_expiry_days" between 1 and 60
        and "merchant_settings"."player_checks_per_hour" between 10 and 1000
        and "merchant_settings"."player_checks_per_day" between 30 and 5000

fulfilment_attempts_unit_cost_check.name: fulfilment_attempts_unit_cost_check
fulfilment_attempts_unit_cost_check.value:
"fulfilment_attempts"."unit_cost_usd_units" >= 0
        and ("fulfilment_attempts"."kind" = 'admin_fulfil' or "fulfilment_attempts"."unit_cost_usd_units" > 0 or "fulfilment_attempts"."proof_file_id" is not null)

fulfilment_attempts_kind_check.name: fulfilment_attempts_kind_check
fulfilment_attempts_kind_check.value:
case "fulfilment_attempts"."kind"
        when 'routed' then "fulfilment_attempts"."route_id" is not null and "fulfilment_attempts"."offer_id" is not null
          and "fulfilment_attempts"."supplier_offer_id" is not null
        else "fulfilment_attempts"."route_id" is null and "fulfilment_attempts"."offer_id" is null and "fulfilment_attempts"."supplier_offer_id" is null
          and "fulfilment_attempts"."status" = 'delivered' and "fulfilment_attempts"."resolved_by" = 'admin'
          and "fulfilment_attempts"."proof_file_id" is not null and not "fulfilment_attempts"."chosen_by_admin"
        end

fulfilment_attempts_resolved_check.name: fulfilment_attempts_resolved_check
fulfilment_attempts_resolved_check.value:
("fulfilment_attempts"."status" in ('delivered', 'failed')) = ("fulfilment_attempts"."resolved_at" is not null)
        and ("fulfilment_attempts"."resolved_at" is null) = ("fulfilment_attempts"."resolved_by" is null)
        and ("fulfilment_attempts"."cost_journal_id" is not null) = ("fulfilment_attempts"."status" = 'delivered' and "fulfilment_attempts"."unit_cost_usd_units" > 0)
        and (not "fulfilment_attempts"."input_rejected" or "fulfilment_attempts"."status" = 'failed')
        and ("fulfilment_attempts"."resolved_by" = 'admin') = ("fulfilment_attempts"."admin_reason" is not null)

fulfilment_attempts_text_check.name: fulfilment_attempts_text_check
fulfilment_attempts_text_check.value:
char_length("fulfilment_attempts"."supplier_offer_id") between 1 and 128
        and char_length("fulfilment_attempts"."supplier_order_id") between 1 and 128
        and char_length("fulfilment_attempts"."failure_reason") between 1 and 200
        and char_length("fulfilment_attempts"."supplier_error_code") between 1 and 64
        and char_length("fulfilment_attempts"."admin_reason") between 5 and 500
        and char_length("fulfilment_attempts"."delivery_reference") between 1 and 200

order_policy_bounds_check.name: order_policy_bounds_check
order_policy_bounds_check.value:
"order_policy"."first_poll_seconds" between 15 and 600
        and "order_policy"."fast_poll_seconds" between 15 and 600
        and "order_policy"."fast_poll_minutes" between 1 and 60
        and "order_policy"."slow_poll_seconds" between 60 and 3600
        and "order_policy"."hard_limit_minutes" between 5 and 240
        and "order_policy"."review_poll_minutes" between 5 and 240
        and "order_policy"."review_poll_hours" between 1 and 72
        and "order_policy"."manual_reminder_minutes" between 5 and 240
        and "order_policy"."owner_daily_cap_usd_units" between 0 and 10000000000
        and "order_policy"."owner_daily_cap_usd_units" % 10000 = 0

order_share_links_revoked_check.name: order_share_links_revoked_check
order_share_links_revoked_check.value:
("order_share_links"."revoked_at" is null) = ("order_share_links"."revoked_by" is null)
        and ("order_share_links"."revoked_by" = 'admin') = ("order_share_links"."revoke_reason" is not null)
        and char_length("order_share_links"."revoke_reason") between 5 and 500

orders_admin_check.name: orders_admin_check
orders_admin_check.value:
("orders"."placed_by" = 'admin') = ("orders"."admin_purpose" is not null)
        and ("orders"."placed_by" = 'admin') = ("orders"."admin_id" is not null)
        and ("orders"."placed_by" = 'admin') = ("orders"."admin_reason" is not null)
        and ("orders"."customer_id" is null) = coalesce("orders"."admin_purpose" = 'walk_in', false)
        and ("orders"."payer" = 'owner')
          = coalesce("orders"."admin_purpose" in ('walk_in', 'gift', 'compensation'), false)
        and ("orders"."customer_note" is null
          or coalesce("orders"."admin_purpose" in ('gift', 'compensation'), false))
        and ("orders"."placed_by" = 'customer'
          or ("orders"."checkout_id" is null and "orders"."reserved_at" is null and not "orders"."is_gift"))
        and ("orders"."customer_id" is not null or not "orders"."is_test")
        and char_length("orders"."admin_reason") between 5 and 500
        and char_length("orders"."customer_note") between 1 and 300

orders_refunded_check.name: orders_refunded_check
orders_refunded_check.value:
"orders"."refunded_usd_units" = "orders"."unit_price_usd_units" * "orders"."refunded_quantity"
        and ("orders"."refunded_quantity" = 0) = ("orders"."refund_journal_id" is null)
        and ("orders"."refunded_quantity" = 0) = ("orders"."refund_reason" is null)

orders_terminal_check.name: orders_terminal_check
orders_terminal_check.value:
("orders"."status" <> 'delivered' or "orders"."delivered_quantity" = "orders"."quantity")
        and ("orders"."status" <> 'partially_refunded' or ("orders"."delivered_quantity" > 0
          and "orders"."refunded_quantity" > 0
          and "orders"."delivered_quantity" + "orders"."refunded_quantity" = "orders"."quantity"))
        and ("orders"."status" <> 'refunded' or ("orders"."delivered_quantity" = 0
          and "orders"."refunded_quantity" = "orders"."quantity"))
        and ("orders"."status" in ('delivered', 'partially_refunded', 'refunded', 'cancelled'))
          = ("orders"."finished_at" is not null)
        and ("orders"."status" = 'delivered') = ("orders"."delivered_at" is not null)
        and ("orders"."status" = 'needs_review') = ("orders"."review_since" is not null)

orders_purchase_journal_check.name: orders_purchase_journal_check
orders_purchase_journal_check.value:
("orders"."purchase_journal_id" is not null) = ("orders"."paid_at" is not null)
        and ("orders"."purchase_journal_id" is not null
          or "orders"."status" = 'awaiting_balance'
          or ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled' and "orders"."paid_at" is null))

orders_reservation_check.name: orders_reservation_check
orders_reservation_check.value:
("orders"."reserved_at" is null) = ("orders"."expires_at" is null)
        and ("orders"."status" <> 'awaiting_balance' or "orders"."reserved_at" is not null)
        and ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("orders"."cancel_reason" is not null)

orders_player_name_check.name: orders_player_name_check
orders_player_name_check.value:
"orders"."player_name" is null
        or ("orders"."player_check" = 'valid' and char_length("orders"."player_name") between 1 and 64)

orders_player_region_check.name: orders_player_region_check
orders_player_region_check.value:
"orders"."player_region" is null
        or ("orders"."player_check" = 'valid' and char_length("orders"."player_region") between 1 and 16)

orders_checkout_check.name: orders_checkout_check
orders_checkout_check.value:
("orders"."checkout_id" is null) = ("orders"."checkout_line" is null)
        and "orders"."checkout_line" between 1 and 50
        and ("orders"."checkout_id" is null or "orders"."reserved_at" is null)

orders_gift_check.name: orders_gift_check
orders_gift_check.value:
("orders"."is_gift" or ("orders"."gift_sender_name" is null and "orders"."gift_message" is null))
        and (not "orders"."is_gift" or "orders"."kind" = 'direct')
        and char_length("orders"."gift_sender_name") between 1 and 30
        and char_length("orders"."gift_message") between 1 and 140

player_checks_player_name_check.name: player_checks_player_name_check
player_checks_player_name_check.value:
"player_checks"."player_name" is null
        or ("player_checks"."result" = 'valid' and char_length("player_checks"."player_name") between 1 and 64)

player_checks_region_check.name: player_checks_region_check
player_checks_region_check.value:
"player_checks"."region" is null
        or ("player_checks"."result" = 'valid' and char_length("player_checks"."region") between 1 and 16)

saved_players_player_name_check.name: saved_players_player_name_check
saved_players_player_name_check.value:
("saved_players"."player_name" is null) = ("saved_players"."name_checked_at" is null)
        and char_length("saved_players"."player_name") between 1 and 64

product_alerts_baseline_check.name: product_alerts_baseline_check
product_alerts_baseline_check.value: ("product_alerts"."kind" = 'price_drop') = ("product_alerts"."baseline_price_usd_units" is not null) and ("product_alerts"."baseline_price_usd_units" is null or ("product_alerts"."baseline_price_usd_units" > 0 and "product_alerts"."baseline_price_usd_units" % 10000 = 0))

product_alerts_ended_check.name: product_alerts_ended_check
product_alerts_ended_check.value: ("product_alerts"."status" = 'active') = ("product_alerts"."ended_at" is null) and ("product_alerts"."status" = 'sent') = ("product_alerts"."sent_at" is not null)

reconciliation_results_range_check.name: reconciliation_results_range_check
reconciliation_results_range_check.value: "reconciliation_results"."allowed_low_units" is null or "reconciliation_results"."allowed_high_units" is null or "reconciliation_results"."allowed_low_units" <= "reconciliation_results"."allowed_high_units"

reconciliation_settings_bounds_check.name: reconciliation_settings_bounds_check
reconciliation_settings_bounds_check.value:
"reconciliation_settings"."tolerance_usd_units" between 0 and 100000000
        and "reconciliation_settings"."tolerance_usd_units" % 10000 = 0
        and "reconciliation_settings"."count_stale_days" between 1 and 60

product_routes_timing_check.name: product_routes_timing_check
product_routes_timing_check.value:
("product_routes"."expected_delivery_minutes" is null or "product_routes"."expected_delivery_minutes" between 1 and 240)
        and ("product_routes"."hard_limit_minutes" is null or "product_routes"."hard_limit_minutes" between 5 and 240)
        and ("product_routes"."expected_delivery_minutes" is null or "product_routes"."hard_limit_minutes" is null
          or "product_routes"."expected_delivery_minutes" < "product_routes"."hard_limit_minutes")

supplier_offers_quantity_check.name: supplier_offers_quantity_check
supplier_offers_quantity_check.value: "supplier_offers"."min_quantity" between 1 and 1000000 and "supplier_offers"."max_quantity" between 1 and 1000000 and "supplier_offers"."min_quantity" <= "supplier_offers"."max_quantity"

supplier_policy_bounds_check.name: supplier_policy_bounds_check
supplier_policy_bounds_check.value:
"supplier_policy"."price_review_threshold_bp" between 100 and 5000
        and "supplier_policy"."cost_stale_minutes" between 30 and 1440
        and "supplier_policy"."health_window_minutes" between 5 and 240
        and "supplier_policy"."health_min_calls" between 1 and 100
        and "supplier_policy"."degraded_success_bp" between 1 and 10000
        and "supplier_policy"."degraded_p90_ms" between 1000 and 120000
        and "supplier_policy"."down_success_bp" between 0 and 9999
        and "supplier_policy"."down_success_bp" < "supplier_policy"."degraded_success_bp"
        and "supplier_policy"."down_consecutive_errors" between 1 and 20
        and "supplier_policy"."probe_after_minutes" between 1 and 120

suppliers_account_checked_check.name: suppliers_account_checked_check
suppliers_account_checked_check.value: ("suppliers"."account_plan" is null) = ("suppliers"."account_checked_at" is null) and ("suppliers"."account_plan" is null) = ("suppliers"."account_active" is null)

support_tickets_link_check.name: support_tickets_link_check
support_tickets_link_check.value: ("support_tickets"."category" = 'order') = ("support_tickets"."order_id" is not null) and ("support_tickets"."category" = 'deposit') = ("support_tickets"."deposit_id" is not null)

support_tickets_closed_check.name: support_tickets_closed_check
support_tickets_closed_check.value: ("support_tickets"."status" = 'closed') = ("support_tickets"."closed_at" is not null and "support_tickets"."closed_by" is not null) and ("support_tickets"."closed_at" is null) = ("support_tickets"."closed_by" is null)

telegram_prompts_deposit_check.name: telegram_prompts_deposit_check
telegram_prompts_deposit_check.value:
("telegram_prompts"."deposit_id" is null) = ("telegram_prompts"."deposit_submitted_at" is null)
        and ("telegram_prompts"."deposit_id" is not null) = ("telegram_prompts"."kind" <> 'stop_confirm')

treasury_movements_external_reference_un.name: treasury_movements_external_reference_unique
treasury_movements_external_reference_un.where: "treasury_movements"."external_reference" is not null and "treasury_movements"."reverses_movement_id" is null

wallet_adjustments_deposit_method_check.name: wallet_adjustments_deposit_method_check
